comment: Pokemon Tower 6F: the Marowak ghost beat (pokefirered data/maps/PokemonTower_6F/scripts.inc, PokemonTower_6F_EventScript_MarowakGhost; corroborated by pokered scripts/PokemonTower6F.asm, MarowakTrigger + MarowakCoords at dbmapcoord 10,16 -- bound tile (20,32), immediately east of the 7F stair warp at (18,32)). The ghost bars the stairs to 7F -- and so bars the events lane's pokemon_tower_fuji_rescue -- until it is calmed. THE SCOPE GATE IS THE ENGINE'S, not the script's: pokefirered src/battle_setup.c StartMarowakBattle checks the bag (CheckBagHasItem ITEM_SILPH_SCOPE). WITH the Scope the battle is BATTLE_TYPE_GHOST | BATTLE_TYPE_GHOST_UNVEILED against a real Marowak (level 30; the engine builds it female, Serious, IV 31); WITHOUT it the battle is BATTLE_TYPE_GHOST only and the engine creates NO enemy at all -- an unidentified GHOST that cannot be damaged, defeated or caught (and even unveiled, a ghost battle dodges every ball: src/battle_script_commands.c's BATTLE_TYPE_GHOST ball-dodge, 'It dodged the thrown BALL! This POKeMON can't be caught!'). PUW form, in the house conventions: the host checks the bag through the item-fixes prep's PUWItemGates.ghost_check(state, 'PokemonTower6F') before running this script and sets the transient flag ghost_unidentified when the Scope is missing (the fossil-pick convention: the runner has no item-check op, the host supplies step data). UNIDENTIFIED branch: the script plays BeGone and the pushback only -- it builds NO battle and sets NO flag; the battle host presents the unidentified ghost battle itself at the trigger (its only exits, fleeing or losing, both land on this pushback, exactly as the source forces the player back and leaves the beat re-triggerable). UNVEILED branch: the battle step (identity only -- the difficulty layer builds the mon; the record in fixed_encounters_additions.json preserves the source's fixed level 30 as authored data for the bind decision, the fixed-encounter house rule). Defeat plays the source's departed sequence -- GhostWasCubonesMother, the Marowak's cry (host presentation; the record carries it), SoulWasCalmed -- and sets marowak_calmed (VAR_MAP_SCENE_POKEMON_TOWER_6F = 1 / EVENT_BEAT_GHOST_MAROWAK's mirror; the same flag PUWFixedEncounters.record_outcome(state, record, 'defeated') writes). Any other outcome (ran, lost) goes to the repelled branch: pushed back one tile EAST -- pokered simulates PAD_RIGHT, away from the stairs which sit west of the trigger in the bound (pokered-converted) layout; FRLG's ForcePlayerUp serves its own rotated layout and is recorded in the record, not used -- and the beat stays live. All three lines are the bound Kanto bank's own PokemonTower6F entries (pokered text); nothing is retyped. requires.forbidden_flags keeps the calmed ghost from re-triggering; Fuji continuity: with marowak_calmed unset the host refuses the 6F->7F stair trigger (the record's blocks entry), so pokemon_tower_fuji_rescue on 7F is unreachable until this beat resolves.
